## ServiceSettings v0.3.0

Phase 2 hardening. The window looks almost the same — the only visible addition is an export/import toolbar at the bottom — but the command layer, storage and state refresh have been rebuilt. v0.2.0 remains available as a separate release.

### Win32 SCM instead of `sc` / `net` text parsing

- The Rust command layer now calls `OpenSCManagerW` → `OpenServiceW` → `QueryServiceStatusEx` / `StartServiceW` / `ControlService` directly. No `sc.exe` / `net.exe` child processes, no shell strings, no `CREATE_NO_WINDOW`, no 20 s subprocess timeout.
- **GBK decoding and the `4  RUNNING` regex are gone.** Running state is read from `SERVICE_STATUS_PROCESS.dwCurrentState == SERVICE_RUNNING` (4), so `START_PENDING` / `STOP_PENDING` can never be misread and Chinese Windows console output no longer needs decoding.
- Win32 error codes are mapped to readable Chinese messages (5 → 拒绝访问, 1060 → 服务不存在, 1056 → 已在运行, 1062 → 未运行, 1053 → 未及时响应); anything else falls back to the system's localized `FormatMessageW` text.
- Each action requests only the access it needs: `status` uses `SERVICE_QUERY_STATUS` (elevation-free), `start` `SERVICE_START`, `stop` `SERVICE_STOP`.
- Elevation behaviour is unchanged: checked once at startup via `TokenElevation`, at most one `runas` relaunch, declining UAC still leaves the window usable.

### Storage: `services.json` instead of IndexedDB

- The list now lives in `app_data_dir()/services.json` as an array of `{ domName, serviceName, status }`; `isChanging` is runtime-only and never persisted.
- Writes are atomic: `services.json.tmp` is renamed into place, so a crash cannot leave a half-written list.
- **One-time migration**: if the JSON file is absent but a v0.2.x IndexedDB list (`TestDB` / `config` / id `1`) exists, `store.js` imports it, saves it to JSON and drops the old database. Upgrading from v0.2.x therefore keeps your cards.
- v0.1.x Electron profiles are still unreachable — those users need to re-add services or import a JSON backup.

### Periodic state refresh

- Every 5 seconds each card re-reads the real service state. Cards being toggled (`isChanging`) or already removed from the DOM are skipped; refresh updates the display only and never writes to disk.
- This closes the behaviour the README used to call out: a service started outside the app no longer needs an app restart to show up.

### Export / import

- Two toolbar buttons at the bottom of the window. Export downloads `service-settings.json` via a browser Blob (no extra Tauri permissions); import reads the file, validates structure, legal service names and duplicates, saves it and reloads the page to reuse the normal startup flow.
- CSP gains `blob:` in `default-src` so the download link can be opened.

### Upgrade notes

| From   | Result                                                                            |
| ------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| v0.2.x | IndexedDB list migrated to `services.json` automatically                          |
| v0.1.x | List not carried over (different runtime profile); re-add or import a JSON backup |

The identifier (`com.makabakax.service-settings`) is unchanged, as are the service-name whitelist, the `{ success, running?, message? }` response shape, the 500 ms switch debounce and the 5000 ms hover-to-delete delay.

### Verification

- `cargo test --lib`: 5 tests pass (injection rejection, camelCase field contract, legacy extra-field tolerance, response shape, real SCM 1060 error mapping)
- `npm run lint`, `npm run build`, `npx prettier --check`: clean
- `npm run tauri build`: NSIS installer produced
